row.title: 14K Gold Engraved Heart Necklace, Personalized with CZ — Only Pendant - No Chain, Yellow Gold
row.description:
Make it personal: this engraved heart necklace can carry a name, a date or a meaningful word on a 12mm solid 14K gold heart with cubic zirconia accents.
The personalized heart necklace hangs on a delicate 1mm chain, a keepsake for anniversaries, Valentine's Day or birthdays.
Details
• Metal: solid 14K gold (585)
• Personalization: custom engraving
• Accents: cubic zirconia
• Pendant size: 12mm x 12mm (0.47" x 0.47")
• Chain: 1mm 14K gold chain
• Weight: about 1.80 g with an 18" chain
• Length: pendant only, or on a 14", 16", 18", 20" or 22" chain
• Colors: yellow, white or rose gold
Why Heon
• Solid 14K gold (58.5% pure gold), stamped 585. Never plated or filled.
• Ships with a certificate of authenticity.
• Free insured shipping. Personalized pieces are made for you and cannot be returned.
Care
Showering in it is fine. Take it off before swimming in a pool or the sea and before workouts, and keep it away from perfume, lotion and household chemicals. Clean with warm water, a drop of mild soap and a soft cloth, then dry well. Store each piece separately to prevent scratches. See our jewelry care guide for more tips.
